patch.title: New client
patch.description: Home, Modes, Collection, Loot, Store, Digi-Farm and Codex in one launcher, with a friends list, a party screen and a match loading screen.

patch.title: Sets
patch.description: Faction Wars, Fates, Galaxies, Gizmos & Gadgets, Reckoning, Dragonlands, Into the Arcane, K.O. Coliseum, Undermons, Auto Chess and Undermons Knockout. Chaos plays a random set every game. Browse every set in the Codex.

patch.title: Digi-Farm
patch.description: Raise your Little Legends on a themed island. Four training mini-games raise their stats.

patch.title: Digivolution
patch.description: Little Legends level up, then digivolve along their own trees up to Ultimate.

patch.title: Digi-Eggs
patch.description: Rare, epic and legendary Little Legends only hatch from eggs. Open them from Loot.

patch.title: Boards and dances
patch.description: 27 arena boards, some react to the fight. 11 dances for kill screens and previews.

patch.title: Item cards
patch.description: Drag an item over a Digimon to see what it will make before you drop it.

events.title: Daily rotation
events.countdown: Missions, the daily bonus and the featured Store row reset in {countdown}.
events.storeDescription: Four items at 25% off, new every day. Your first game today pays {bits} extra Bits.
events.farmDescription: Hunger, energy and happiness run on real time, also while the game is closed. Check on your partners.

sets.title: Faction Wars
sets.desc: The original roster: Digi-Destined partners, Tamers, Savers, Frontier and Xros Wars lines, with Royal Knights and Demon Lords at 5 cost. Hyper Roll rules and Data Wisps.

sets.title: Fates
sets.desc: Partner Digimon: some shop slots offer a Champion-form Partner whose marked trait counts double. One Partner at a time. Hyper Roll rules, Digi-Forge artifacts.

sets.title: Galaxies
sets.desc: TFT Set 3 on Digimon: DigiDestined, Dark Area, DigiXros fusions and Data Pirates. Every game rolls one Galaxy, a rule that changes the game for every Tamer.

sets.title: Gizmos & Gadgets
sets.desc: Inventors, pirates and Dark Masters in a gadget city. Three Digivice upgrades per game in Silver, Gold and Prismatic, with the tiers shown in advance by Hextech Gates.

sets.title: Reckoning
sets.desc: The Dark Spore spreads: Shadow items trade a drawback for power, and the Radiant Blessing lifts Tamers who fall low. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.title: Dragonlands
sets.desc: Mega Dragons that take two team slots, a Treasure Dragon round, Golden Armor gold items and fixed augment rounds with one reroll. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.title: Into the Arcane
sets.desc: Kowloon gangs, the Bagra Army, DigiPolice and the Rebels. At 4-3 you mutate one Digimon with an Anomaly; Syndicate Digimon trade Shimmer at the black market. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.title: K.O. Coliseum
sets.desc: A Digimon fighting tournament. Feed Digi-Cores to pick digivolution paths, choose Justimon's arm and Labramon's partner, and bank gems with Jewel Gambit. Plays at Hyper Roll or Normal pace.

sets.title: Undermons
sets.desc: Undermons: 26 alliances, tiered items with no recipes, creep rounds, and a Tamer on your board from round 10 who ranks up every 5 rounds.

sets.title: Auto Chess
sets.desc: Auto Chess: races and classes, 2-copy Druids, Wizards, creep loot, interest and XP.

sets.title: Undermons Knockout
sets.desc: Undermons Knockout: 4 lives, 2 copies digivolve, a starter crew, an item every other round and a Tamer from round 2. About 10 minutes.

sets.title: Chaos
sets.desc: A random set every game, picked from the game seed. Every Tamer in the lobby plays the same set.

multiplayer.title: Lobbies of 8
multiplayer.desc: Create a lobby, send the invite to your friends and fill the empty seats with AI Tamers. Take any AI seat that is still alive mid-game.

farm.title: Raise your partners
farm.desc: Your Little Legends live on a themed island. Feed them, train them in four mini-games and watch them grow.

evolution.title: Digivolve
evolution.desc: Little Legends earn Digi-Data from every game, level up and digivolve along their own trees up to Ultimate.
